reason: A desktop companion plugin centered on an interactive animated pet, local status and inventory management, and optional DeepSeek-powered dialogue.

summaries.zh: 一款常驻桌面的互动宠物插件，提供动画立绘、状态养成、道具商店、互动动作和可选的 DeepSeek AI 对话。
summaries.en: A desktop companion plugin featuring animated pet interactions, status and inventory management, an item shop, and optional DeepSeek AI conversations.

capabilities: Provides a draggable and hideable desktop pet interface
Tracks and persists pet status, inventory, dialogue history, and progression locally
Uses a user-configured DeepSeek API key for AI conversations
Tracks token consumption and awards in-plugin points for purchases
